data.summary: The batch5 directory contains CSV datasets representing core e-commerce entities including customers, orders, order items, and products, serving as a data layer for analysis or ingestion.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV header file for customers containing customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, and updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores customer identification data, names, cities, and membership tiers.

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.summary: Order items detail records CSV file.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains order item records with order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Tracks individual items associated with orders, including product IDs, quantities, and unit prices.

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.source_summary: Contains order records with order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, and updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains transactional order headers linking customers to orders along with status and timestamps.

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.source_summary: Contains product records with product_id, name, category, price, and updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores productcatalog data including names, categories, and prices.
